description: Figure 3(b) is a line plot that displays the BLEU scores for a GPT-NEO 1.3B model trained on the target dataset $D_t$. The x-axis represents the training epoch, with values ranging from 0.5 to 3.0 in increments of 0.5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, scaled from 1.0 to 4.0. The plot contains a single line, which is green and has a solid line style. This line shows a generally increasing trend in BLEU scores over the course of training. The score starts at approximately 3.3 at epoch 0.5 and rises to a value of about 3.7 by epoch 3.0.
